outcomes.text: DRAFT. Keepers are paid their gas, a 50,000-gas overhead allowance and 0.0001 ETH per useful call (owner-approved, D14); the storage refunds they also keep add at most 0.002 ETH per 180 draws.

DRAFT. All buyers fund restocking fees: the fee is built into every draw price (about 0.001 ETH per draw at 0.5 gwei on the launch board); the creator fronts the fees of prizes still listed, never more than one board at the 5 gwei cap (55 Shapes x 0.0047 ETH).
DRAFT. Unused restocking fees go to the creator: right after closing, every wei in the Balancer is claimable except the keeper pay held for draws not yet reconciled (D3).
DRAFT. Exact redeemable backing: every prize unlisted redeems for exactly its backing.

DRAFT. When prizes are missing for lack of ETH, the dashboard offers Add ETH and Continue without them; after either, no day ends with a prize missing from the design (D9). Without either action (large_win) prizes can stay missing: shown as information.

DRAFT. Closeout returns everything: after the closeout the Balancer, its listed backing and its FWA proceeds hold nothing. Exception, under FWA's rules: an NFT whose delivery failed stays at FWA until its winner takes the refund.

DRAFT. The fill gate never blocks the sales that refill prizes: with every draw reconciled, no draw is refused for low inventory while gas is within the 5 gwei cap. A board with less than 17 x 0.01 ETH Shapes' prize weight also pauses while draws are unsettled (top_heavy regime; the planner warns the creator) (D8).
DRAFT. The first 10% of Shape markup goes to the game: profit credited to the creator stays under the markup above 10% (at a 25% markup, 12% of proceeds).
DRAFT. The creator's profit follows the board each draw was priced on: with restocks listed while draws are in flight, profit booked beyond that split stays under 0.001 ETH per 180 draws.

DRAFT. A player pays at most 1.5x the expected Shape backing of a draw at normal gas (basefee 0.1 gwei): FWA's all-in quote (draw price and randomness fee) against the backing weighted as FWA weighs draws, checked before every draw on the launch board (R19). At 1 and 5 gwei the ratio is shown as information.

DRAFT (R4; owner chose this outcome, D12). On the launch board the restocking fees repaid inside won prizes cover keeper pay for play (upkeep after draws; the creator's own setup work excluded): no loss over 180 draws at 0.1 to 5 gwei, through a gas spike and a randomness outage. NFT-dominated boards (extreme_top_heavy, largest_board) lose up to 0.035 ETH per 180 draws on play: shown as information.

DRAFT (R8; owner chose this outcome, D13). In quiet operation of the launch board the creator ends ahead after 180 draws, counting everything claimed or still theirs against everything deposited and NFTs given away, at 0.1, 0.5, 2 and 5 gwei. Prize luck (two forced 0.5 ETH wins: -0.17 ETH) and zero demand (-0.07 ETH of setup cost) are shown as information.
